chapters.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on vLLM · concurrency 1 · Jetson AGX Thor
chapters.subtitle: one request at a time
chapters.note: the latency case: no other token to share a weight read with — 2.02x
chapters.footer:
two separate processes, and they have to be: a serving engine bakes its model tree into a compiled, graph-captured decode path at load time, so the seats are bound by a hook that fires after load_model and before the engine's first trace — nothing is forked, replaced or reimplemented
teacher-forced same-token 0.949, against a floor of 0.993 for the engine scored against its own tokens; most of that distance is the expert bank at four bits · Jetson AGX Thor, sm_110 · vLLM 0.26.0 · 200 seats — 160 dense projections + 40 routed expert banks — plus the LM head in 4 row slabs, 0 refused · 128 tokens, greedy, thinking off
